tips.text: Pledge Steel Meridian first so Red Veil climbs with it, buy both parts, then switch the pledge to Suda for the Barrel.
Do Cephalon Suda last; earning its standing burns Red Veil standing.
Buy each part the moment you reach Rank 2; swapping pledges costs standing with the opposed syndicate, not parts you own.
Keep Suda and Red Veil above zero when you swap pledges; Rank -1 brings Eximus death squads and costs a Forma and 50,000 credits to climb back.
Run the daily Syndicate Alerts and cash in the medallions; they ignore the daily cap.
Stop at Rank 2 in each syndicate; every Velocitus part is sold there.
Join a public dojo or a free-research clan if you have no Tenno Lab; it only needs the research done when you buy the blueprint.
Players call it one of the more reasonable Arch-gun farms: standing and credits with no drop luck, a few days of caps.
